name: Daewoo
overview: Popular 1990s and early-2000s Korean value brand in Australia, known for 'Free Care' 3-year servicing before its models were absorbed into Holden.
australian_history:
Daewoo Automotive Australia was established in 1994 by South Korea's massive industrial chaebol, Daewoo Corporation. Entering the market with the 1.5i hatchback and Espero mid-size sedan (featuring Bertone styling), Daewoo quickly made headlines with the 'Free Care' program, which included 3 years or 100,000 km of free scheduled maintenance, parts, and labour—an Australian industry first that drastically lowered barriers to entry for budget car buyers.

In 1995, Daewoo introduced the Cielo (an evolution of the 1.5i/Opel Kadett). In 1997, Daewoo launched its second-generation lineup with styling commissioned from legendary Italian design houses: the compact Lanos (styled by Giorgetto Giugiaro / Italdesign), the Nubira small car (I.DE.A Institute), and the Leganza executive sedan (Giugiaro). In 1999, the Matiz micro-car joined the range, becoming one of Australia's cheapest city runabouts.

Following the collapse of the Daewoo Group during the late-1990s Asian financial crisis, General Motors acquired Daewoo's core automotive assets in 2002 to form GM Daewoo (GMDAT). In Australia, General Motors-Holden began leveraging GM Daewoo's cost-effective manufacturing. By late 2004, the standalone Daewoo brand was officially retired in Australia. Subsequent GM Daewoo vehicles were re-engineered by Holden in Melbourne and sold under the Holden lion badge: the Daewoo Kalos became the Holden Barina (TK), the Lacetti and Tacuma became the Holden Viva (JF), the Magnus became the Holden Epica (EP), and the Winstorm became the popular Holden Captiva (CG).

models_catalog.name: Lanos
models_catalog.overview: Giugiaro-styled light car, a top-selling budget runabout with Daewoo's 3-year Free Care package.

generations.summary: 1.5L SOHC (63kW) and 1.6L DOHC (78kW) engines; SE, SX, and Sport trims.

models_catalog.name: Matiz
models_catalog.overview: Tiny 5-door city runabout styled by Italdesign Giugiaro, offering 5-door versatility in a sub-3.5m length.

generations.summary: 796cc 3-cylinder engine (38kW), 5-speed manual, air conditioning and power steering standard.

models_catalog.name: Nubira
models_catalog.overview: Spacious compact car engineered in the UK and styled by I.DE.A Institute in Italy.

generations.summary: 1.6L and 2.0L DOHC engines, SE and CDX grades, exceptional wagon load volume.

models_catalog.name: Leganza
models_catalog.overview: Daewoo's flagship luxury sedan, styled by Giugiaro with Lotus-assisted suspension tuning.

generations.summary: 2.0L and 2.2L DOHC engines (100kW), leather interior, woodgrain trim; SX and CDX.
